explanation: Try all one-to-three-digit lengths for the first three IPv4 components. Validate each component’s range and leading-zero rule, then append every valid four-part address.
timeComplexity: O(n) input-character copying across a constant number of splits; O(1) for valid IPv4-sized inputs
